body:
## Description
Develop a complexity scoring system to estimate simulation difficulty and resource requirements.

## Factors to Consider
- Number of nodes and components
- Presence of nonlinear elements
- Number of reactive components (L, C)
- Circuit topology (loops, connectivity)
- Source complexity (DC, AC, transient)

## Scoring System
- Simple (1-3): < 10 components, linear, DC only
- Moderate (4-6): 10-50 components, some reactive
- Complex (7-9): 50-200 components, nonlinear elements
- Very Complex (10): 200+ components, many nonlinear

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define scoring algorithm
- [ ] Calculate complexity score
- [ ] Predict simulation time
- [ ] Estimate memory requirements
- [ ] Suggest solver settings

## Priority
Low - Nice to have for UX but not essential
title: Feature: Circuit Complexity Scoring
